name.zh: Terraria 与 tModLoader 仓库调试任务

description.en: Independently authored source-level repairs over frozen real mod repositories, evaluated offline against production code paths.
description.zh: 基于真实模组冻结源码、逐题独立设计的源码级修复任务，通过生产代码路径离线评测。

title.zh: 修复 Magic Storage 压缩 I/O 回归

summary.en: Repair nested framing, full-width scalar, long-string, malformed-length, item-codec, and transactional-send failures in Magic Storage's production binary format.
summary.zh: 修复 Magic Storage 生产二进制格式中的嵌套帧、全宽标量、长字符串、畸形长度、物品编解码与事务发送故障。

brief.en: Diagnose eleven interacting operator reports while preserving unaffected encodings and failure isolation.
brief.zh: 诊断十一组相互影响的运营者报告，同时保持未受影响的编码与失败隔离行为。

en: Repair all eleven reported behavior groups in the existing production files.
Keep the submission source-only and preserve public signatures.
zh: 在现有生产源码中修复全部十一组报告行为。
保持提交仅含源码并维持公共签名。

en: Preserve Magic Storage's ValueReader, ValueWriter, compressed-string, and NetCompression contracts.
zh: 保持 Magic Storage 的 ValueReader、ValueWriter、压缩字符串与 NetCompression 合同。

en: All 68 private offline source-projection cases must pass without network access.
zh: 全部 68 个私有离线源码投影用例必须在无网络环境中通过。

tasks.evaluation_boundary: layered offline .NET 8 source projection plus pinned real tModLoader 2026.7.3.0 dedicated-server assertions against Terraria 1.4.4.9; disclosed client-only behavior remains source-projection-only

title.zh: 修复 Fargo 魔法树事务

summary.en: Repair item insertion, graph compaction, branch expansion, paid duplication, recipe snapshots, network state, and once-per-frame updates in Fargo's Mutant Mod's Enchanted Tree.
summary.zh: 修复 Fargo 突变体模组魔法树的物品插入、图压缩、分支展开、付费复制、配方快照、网络状态与逐帧唯一更新。

brief.en: Reconstruct one tile-entity feature across interaction, lifecycle, persistence, multiplayer, and collection-mutation boundaries.
brief.zh: 跨交互、生命周期、持久化、多人同步与集合变更边界重建同一方块实体功能。

en: Repair all fifteen reported behavior groups in the existing production files.
Preserve public signatures and keep the submission source-only.
zh: 在现有生产源码中修复全部十五组报告行为。
保持公共签名并确保提交仅含源码。

en: Preserve FargoItemSets policy, ModSystem recipe lifecycle, ModTile interaction, and ModTileEntity save/network contracts.
zh: 保持 FargoItemSets 策略、ModSystem 配方生命周期、ModTile 交互与 ModTileEntity 存档/网络合同。

en: All 78 private offline source-projection cases must pass without network access.
zh: 全部 78 个私有离线源码投影用例必须在无网络环境中通过。

brief.en: Keep five coupled storage representations and a reentrant ModSystem lifecycle consistent across capacity and counter boundaries.
brief.zh: 在容量与计数器边界上保持五个耦合存储表示及可重入 ModSystem 生命周期一致。

en: Repair all sixteen reported behavior groups in the existing production files.
Preserve existing type/method surfaces and keep the submission source-only.
zh: 在现有生产源码中修复全部十六组报告行为。
保持既有类型/方法接口并确保提交仅含源码。

en: Preserve Overhaul's Component, DataEntity, Query, SparseSet, and ModSystem chunk lifecycle contracts.
zh: 保持 Overhaul 的 Component、DataEntity、Query、SparseSet 与 ModSystem 区块生命周期合同。

brief.en: Keep drag geometry, rollback, world mutation, inventory accounting, execution order, and exact dirty synchronization consistent across client/server paths.
brief.zh: 保持拖拽几何、回滚、世界变更、库存计账、执行顺序和精确脏区同步在客户端/服务端路径间一致。
